ideas.title: Investigation into Federal Reserve Investigation
ideas.description: This story would investigate the circumstances surrounding the judge's decision to quash subpoenas in the Federal Reserve investigation.
questions: What evidence did the DOJ present to support their investigation?
What are the implications of the judge's decision for the investigation?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to reveal significant information about the investigation and the DOJ's methods, which could have far-reaching implications for the financial sector and the public's trust in government institutions.
